notes: No file under /workspace was modified except this review.json. Expectations were derived independently with exact integer arithmetic on prices scaled by 10**6 (cents = (S + 5000) // 10000), not by comparing against the implementation.

checks.name: existing-test-suite
checks.finding: Frozen suite passes unchanged; fixture_identity.json untouched ({"fixture":"frozen-synthetic-v1"}).

checks.name: half-up-tie-at-total
checks.finding: Ties at the final total round half-up (away from zero), e.g. 3x0.005 = 0.015 -> 0.02.

checks.name: no-per-line-rounding
checks.command_or_input: 3 lines of price '0.004', qty 1 ; 2 lines of '0.005' ; 1000 lines of '0.000001'
checks.finding: Sum is exact before the single final rounding: 3x0.004 = 0.012 -> 0.01 (per-line rounding would give 0.00); 2x0.005 = 0.010 -> 0.01 (per-line would give 0.02).

checks.name: extreme-domain-values
checks.finding: 16-integer-digit / 6-fractional-digit boundary is exact; no float drift (e.g. 9007199254740993.99 is preserved).

checks.name: low-caller-precision-and-context-immutability
checks.expected: '0.02' and '1234567890123456123.46' with prec/rounding/Emax/Emin identical before and after
checks.observed: '0.02' and '1234567890123456123.46'; global prec == 8 afterwards (prec, rounding, Emax, Emin unchanged)
checks.finding: Exactness is preserved under a tiny caller precision because the module uses integer-scaled arithmetic plus a localcontext; the global decimal context is not mutated.

checks.name: invalid-input-rejection
checks.command_or_input: 25 probes: prices '-1.00','nan','inf','Infinity','1e3','+1','1'+'0'*16,'0.0000001','',' 1',1,1.5,True,None; quantities True,False,1.0,Decimal?,1001,-1,10**9,'3',None; rows missing price/quantity, row='1', row=None
checks.observed: ValueError for all 25 probes (no wrong exception type, no silent acceptance)
checks.finding: bool quantity/price is rejected before the int/str check; float quantities are rejected; out-of-range (1001, -1, 10**9) rejected; missing keys and non-mapping rows raise ValueError (not TypeError/KeyError).

issues.description: No genuine discrepancy found. One initial probe case used the input '0.1249999' (7 fractional digits), which is illegal per spec, so the ValueError raised was correct; re-run with the legal '0.124999' produced the independently expected '0.12'. This was a reviewer-probe error, not an implementation defect.

Spec ambiguity only: price strings with redundant leading zeros (e.g. '00.50') are accepted when the total integer digit count is <= 16, consistent with the frozen test test_zero_padded_and_plain_forms; 17+ integer digits (including leading zeros) are rejected. None of this contradicts the stated spec.

verdict: PASS - invoice.total conforms to the stated spec on all independent probes (half-up final rounding only, exact decimal summation, extreme 16-digit/6-decimal values, low caller precision without global-context mutation, and strict ValueError validation). No real discrepancy found.
